complete.description: full backup — complete tool outputs, both JSONL products and the raw session, with touched-file lists (heavy)

source.description: the raw session, losslessly — one native-JSON file per session (fast, compact)

study.description: a readable log plus structured memory and a searchable text corpus, no raw copy (medium)

review.description: the readable log without reasoning, plus the raw session (does not redact)

notes.description: plain read — every message, tool output truncated to ~500 chars (light)

tool-output.description: tool calls and outputs only — reasoning and patches omitted

conversation.description: the dialogue only — no tools, patches or reasoning (light)

prompts.description: just your prompts — no answers, reasoning or tools (task log)

memory.description: memory.jsonl: one structured memory profile per root session — first ask, last answer, todos, tools, tokens and digests

corpus.description: corpus.jsonl: one flat text document per root session, with all message parts inline
